# Dynamic_Programming_Reservoir_State

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
The intermediate states generated during dynamic programming iterations are treated as high-dimensional reservoir states, capturing problem structure for downstream readout. This enables TCC/iNEST systems to leverage existing computational pipelines as reusable, energy-efficient substrates for combinatorial problem solving.
